title: Add Missing Footer Styles
description: Implement CSS styles for the site-footer component and all its child elements to create a professional, well-formatted footer consistent with the existing design system.

phases.name: Footer Base Layout Styles
phases.description: Create base styling for the main footer container and layout structure

subtasks.title: Add site-footer base styles
subtasks.description: Style the .site-footer element with appropriate background, borders, and positioning to visually separate it from main content
acceptance_criteria: Footer has distinct background color using design tokens
Footer has top border for visual separation
subtasks.notes: Added .site-footer base styles with background-alt color, top border, and section spacing. All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Add footer-container styles
subtasks.description: Style the .footer-container with container width, max-width, and padding consistent with existing container patterns
acceptance_criteria: Proper horizontal centering with auto margins
subtasks.notes: Added .footer-container styles with width: 100%, max-width using design token, auto margins for centering, and consistent padding. Follows the existing .container pattern exactly. All acceptance criteria met.

phases.name: Footer Content Section Styles
phases.description: Style the main content area with contact information and CTA

subtasks.title: Add footer-content layout styles
subtasks.description: Style the .footer-content wrapper with flexbox layout to arrange footer-contact and footer-info side by side on desktop
acceptance_criteria: Responsive: stacks vertically on mobile, side-by-side on tablet+
subtasks.notes: Added .footer-content flexbox layout with column direction on mobile and row direction on tablet+ (768px). Uses design token --spacing-lg for gap. Follows existing responsive patterns. All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Add footer-contact styles
subtasks.description: Style the .footer-contact section including the h3 heading and contact detail paragraphs (.contact-name, .contact-location, .contact-region)
acceptance_criteria: h3 heading styled appropriately for footer context
Contact details use proper typography and spacing
Uses design system colors and fonts
subtasks.notes: Added .footer-contact section styles with h3 heading and contact detail paragraphs (.contact-name, .contact-location, .contact-region). Used design system tokens for typography, colors, and spacing. Contact name is bold for emphasis, location and region use lighter color for visual hierarchy. All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Add footer-info and footer-cta styles
subtasks.description: Style the .footer-info section and .footer-cta paragraph for the call-to-action text
acceptance_criteria: CTA text is visually distinct and readable
subtasks.notes: Added .footer-info section styles with flex: 1 for proper layout balance, and .footer-cta paragraph styles with design token typography (--font-size-base, --color-text, --line-height-base) and margin-bottom: 0. The CTA text is now visually distinct and readable, following existing footer patterns. All acceptance criteria met.

phases.name: Footer Bottom Section Styles
phases.description: Style the bottom bar with copyright and legal navigation

subtasks.title: Add footer-bottom layout styles
subtasks.description: Style the .footer-bottom section with flexbox layout, top border separation, and proper spacing
acceptance_criteria: Visually separated from content area above
subtasks.notes: Added .footer-bottom styles with flexbox layout (column on mobile, row with space-between on tablet+), top border separation using --color-border, and proper spacing with --spacing-lg for margin-top and padding-top. Includes responsive media query for tablet+ (768px). All acceptance criteria met.

subtasks.title: Add copyright styles
subtasks.description: Style the .copyright paragraph with appropriate typography for legal text
acceptance_criteria: Uses smaller font size appropriate for legal text

subtasks.title: Add footer-nav styles
subtasks.description: Style the .footer-nav navigation including the ul/li list and anchor links for legal pages
acceptance_criteria: Proper link styling with hover states

phases.name: Responsive Adjustments
phases.description: Add responsive media queries for mobile, tablet, and desktop layouts

subtasks.title: Add mobile responsive styles
subtasks.description: Add @media (max-width: 767px) styles for mobile footer layout with stacked content and centered text
acceptance_criteria: Text is centered for mobile view
Proper spacing adjustments for smaller screens

subtasks.title: Add tablet and desktop responsive styles
subtasks.description: Add @media queries for tablet (768px+) and desktop (1024px+) with horizontal layouts
acceptance_criteria: Proper spacing scales for larger screens

phases.name: Testing and Verification
phases.description: Verify the footer styles work correctly across browsers and devices

subtasks.title: Build and visual verification
subtasks.description: Build the site and verify footer renders correctly with proper styling
acceptance_criteria: Footer is visually distinct from main content
All text is readable and properly formatted
Links are functional with hover states
